Tata Trusts Challenges N. Chandrasekaran's Reappointment as Chairman

Tata Trusts has rejected and declared illegal the reappointment of N. Chandrasekaran as Chairman of Tata Sons. The Trusts stated that the reappointment was made without the required majority vote from their nominated directors, as stipulated by the Articles of Association. The Trusts challenged the decision on September 20.
